basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid tabletop gamer and aspiring miniatures painter based in Fort Myers. I spend a lot of my free time customizing miniatures for Warhammer 40k, and when I'm not doing that, I'm exploring the great outdoors on my Africa Twin. I work as a middle-school science teacher, which means my weekdays are pretty busy, but I get a lot of joy from helping kids discover the wonders of science. I'm single, and when I'm not in the classroom or painting minis, you can find me at the local brewpub with friends or online during the late evening hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of Warhammer 40k, gained through years of gaming and painting. I started in college when a friend introduced me to tabletop games, and since then, I've been hooked. My experience is largely self-taught through online tutorials and participating in local gaming groups. Additionally, I have a keen interest in motorcycles, especially adventure bikes like the Africa Twin. I'm also reasonably knowledgeable about craft beers, thanks to many visits to local breweries.
